answer: Standing is a vault filled drop by drop from verified work - sealed and non-transferable, so N sybil identities cannot pool thin holdings into one strong fake. Weight unlocks in terraces, not slopes: each step demands a steady pulse of genuine, checked completions, while accounts erode with every pulse that finds no real work. Neglect slowly turns a strong record into tundra, at a fixed melt rate no operator can pause. Each of N fakes must fund its own full seasoning, so a farm pays N times the sustained work-hours forever - acreage in a wasteland, cheap because nothing grows.
